_comment: System Settings has a technical minimum height of 700 but a built-in cap of 620. Physics must win: it is placed at 700, not 620. Regression for issue #8, where the per-window height clamp applied the cap with no floor check, planning windows shorter than the app will accept. A terminal takes the hero slot so System Settings keeps its cap (the hero's cap is deliberately nulled).

windows.title: technical minimum exceeds its own cap
